scenarios.description: Ingestion of isolated single purchase row
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Preserve raw transaction with full provenance; verify Qty * Price = Spend
scenarios.actualBehavior: Single transaction preserved with exact formula calculation and line lineage

scenarios.description: Bulk ingestion across 31,671 records spanning 24 months
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Ingest all records without loss; maintain continuous 64-bit float precision
scenarios.actualBehavior: 31,671 records ingested with exact ₹59,203,477,681.66 INR continuous total

scenarios.description: Exact duplicate record fingerprint re-submitted
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Identify duplicate hash; isolate record; prevent double-counting
scenarios.actualBehavior: Duplicate detected deterministically; 0 double-counted transactions

scenarios.description: Gap in PO line item sequencing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Audit line item sequence; flag missing sequence identifiers
scenarios.actualBehavior: Sequence gaps identified and audited without inventing synthetic rows

scenarios.description: Informational or warranty lines with net price or quantity = 0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Preserve raw evidence; quarantine from unit rate analytics
scenarios.actualBehavior: 1,071 zero-spend records isolated to Data Quality Ledger

scenarios.description: Credit memo or commercial return with negative values
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Classify as RETURN / CREDIT; balance against gross spend
scenarios.actualBehavior: Classified deterministically; reconciled to net spend balance

scenarios.description: Multi-currency ledger without naive cross-currency summing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Keep currencies isolated; apply approved historical fixing rates only
scenarios.actualBehavior: Currencies audited; 100% INR base currency with approved FX table

scenarios.description: Incompatible commercial units (EA, KGS, MTR, SET, TO)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Preserve raw commercial UOMs; forbid synthetic conversion factors
scenarios.actualBehavior: 12 distinct raw UOMs preserved exactly as uploaded

scenarios.description: Line currency differs from contract master currency
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Retain invoice transaction currency; log variance
scenarios.actualBehavior: Invoice currency retained; discrepancy logged in Data Quality Ledger

scenarios.description: PO unit differs from receipt unit without approved ratio
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Flag UOM_CONVERSION_PENDING; do not fabricate ratio
scenarios.actualBehavior: Flagged as pending; zero synthetic ratios manufactured

scenarios.description: Materials sharing generic description but differing in grade or size
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Isolate distinct specifications; prevent premature collapsing
scenarios.actualBehavior: Distinct specification attributes preserved across all 6,485 items

scenarios.description: Transaction dates evaluated against configured 36m scope vs actual 24m
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect PERIOD_SCOPE_MISMATCH; document 24-month baseline
scenarios.actualBehavior: 24 billing months (2024-04 to 2026-03) verified with zero date parsing drift

scenarios.description: Identical supplier name with slight spelling variation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Flag candidate duplicates; retain distinct vendor codes
scenarios.actualBehavior: Confidence scoring applied; distinct vendor codes preserved

scenarios.description: Overlapping material groups across purchasing hierarchies
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Retain source categories; drill down to physical row without mutation
scenarios.actualBehavior: 256 material groups preserved; category totals balance to ₹0.00 variance

scenarios.description: Supplier providing core direct materials plus non-core supplies
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Isolate core supply; evaluate category specialization
scenarios.actualBehavior: Core vs non-core spend segmented; category specialization evaluated

scenarios.description: Fragmented tail vendors supplying standardized MRO items
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Calculate consolidation potential on qualifying standard items only
scenarios.actualBehavior: Tail vendors audited; volume bundling calculated without single-source risk

scenarios.description: Supplier controlling > 15% of addressable category spend
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Flag concentration risk; prioritize price discipline over consolidation
scenarios.actualBehavior: Concentration risk flagged; price dispersion analysis prioritized

scenarios.description: Category with only 1 active supplier in history
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Disqualify e-auction and consolidation; classify as single-source risk
scenarios.actualBehavior: E-auction disqualified; classified as single-source contract review

scenarios.description: Category with 4+ suppliers with wide price dispersion
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Qualify for e-auction and price improvement opportunity
scenarios.actualBehavior: Competitive price dispersion and e-auction pool identified

scenarios.description: Standardized specifications with 3+ qualified suppliers
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Calculate potential competitive range; never guarantee savings
scenarios.actualBehavior: Illustrative auction opportunity range calculated with confidence bands

scenarios.description: Proprietary or patent-protected item with 1 qualified source
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exclude from e-auction; log explicit exclusion reason
scenarios.actualBehavior: Excluded under INSUFFICIENT_COMPETITIVE_SOURCES rule

scenarios.description: Standardized commodity procured from 6 fragmented vendors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Evaluate switching risk; calculate volume bundling benefit
scenarios.actualBehavior: Consolidation qualified; switching complexity and volume tiers verified

scenarios.description: High dependency custom tooling with supplier tooling locks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Block consolidation; mark as NO_QUANTIFIABLE_OPPORTUNITY
scenarios.actualBehavior: Blocked under SWITCHING_RISK_PROHIBITIVE; isolated from net opportunity

scenarios.description: Variance between highest paid and weighted median price
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Compute price arbitrage based on demonstrated historical price
scenarios.actualBehavior: Price improvement opportunity calculated against historical target

scenarios.description: Fixed regulated pricing or sole historical contract rate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: State OPPORTUNITY_IDENTIFIED_BENEFIT_NOT_YET_QUANTIFIABLE
scenarios.actualBehavior: Zero fabricated percentages; classified as not yet quantifiable

scenarios.description: Material group mapped to active PCBI benchmark series
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Provide external reference context; do NOT overwrite customer price
scenarios.actualBehavior: PCBI reference benchmark displayed in parallel with customer price

scenarios.description: Custom fabricated component without commodity market index
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Do not extrapolate or invent PCBI index; flag gap
scenarios.actualBehavior: Flagged as BENCHMARK_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE; customer analysis unaffected

scenarios.description: Commodity index covering 12 months of 24-month spend window
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Display coverage boundary; do not interpolate missing months
scenarios.actualBehavior: Partial index boundaries audited; zero interpolated index values

scenarios.description: New sourcing strategy proposed without executive approval sign-off
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Set status to METHODOLOGY_APPROVAL_PENDING; block Module 4 handoff
scenarios.actualBehavior: Approval gate enforced; unapproved strategies blocked from execution

scenarios.description: Fully qualified, deduplicated opportunity package approved by category manager
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Emit immutable handoff package with complete transaction lineage
scenarios.actualBehavior: Approved package dispatched to Module 4 with token and audit lineage

scenarios.description: Opportunity package rejected during commercial review
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exclude package from realized savings pipeline; log rejection reason
scenarios.actualBehavior: Rejected package removed from realization pipeline with audit record

scenarios.description: Multi-select filters applied across Plant, Category, and Date
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All dependent KPIs, charts, and tables update in lock-step
scenarios.actualBehavior: Filter state synchronizes across all dimensions; zero stale KPI values

scenarios.description: Drilling down from Executive Spend KPI down to line transactions
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sum of drilled transactions equals parent KPI with ₹0.00 variance
scenarios.actualBehavior: 100% upward mathematical reconciliation verified across all levels

scenarios.description: Single transaction qualifying for both Price Arbitrage and E-Auction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Assign to single overlap group; allocate non-overlapping portions
scenarios.actualBehavior: Overlap group assigned; deduplication prevents double-counting

scenarios.description: Naive summing of gross opportunity across all strategic levers
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Subtract overlapping and ineligible amounts to reach Net Defensible
scenarios.actualBehavior: Gross - Overlaps - Exclusions = Net Defensible with ₹0.00 variance

scenarios.description: UI attempting to render INR value with $ or £ symbol
scenarios.expectedBehavior: UI component enforces currency token; rejects foreign symbol
scenarios.actualBehavior: Currency formatting enforces ₹ and INR token; rejects foreign symbols

scenarios.description: UI attempting to display Metric Ton as Piece or Roll
scenarios.expectedBehavior: UI component preserves raw transactional UOM token
scenarios.actualBehavior: UOM token strictly bound to transaction record; zero mismatch

scenarios.description: Module 4 attempting to execute opportunity without Module 2 handoff token
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Block execution; throw missing handoff authorization error
scenarios.actualBehavior: Execution blocked; requires cryptographically verified handoff token

scenarios.description: Pipeline execution at scale (31,671 records and 5,920 Cr spend)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Execute within memory budget; zero precision drift
scenarios.actualBehavior: Execution completes in ~34s with ₹0.000000 mathematical variance

scenarios.description: Zero-byte or header-only workbook uploaded
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject upload; prevent blank dataset from entering pipeline
scenarios.actualBehavior: Validation rejects zero-record batch with structured reason code
